current_question: Tick the favorable chair conformation and draw the structure of K by completing the CD template. Show stereochemistry unambiguously.
question:
## Shared official problem context
T9. Cyclodextrin Chemistry 7% Cyclodextrins (CD) are a family of cyclic oligosaccharides, consisting of glucose subunits joined by α1,4-glycosidic bonds. The three most common cyclodextrins (α-, β-, γ-cyclodextrin) contain 6, 7, and 8 α-D-glucopyranoside units, respectively. 9.1 Calculate the molar mass of β-CD. Assume M𝑤(glucose) = 180.16 g mol−1. CDs combine macrocyclic properties with glucose chemistry, which was demonstrated in the synthesis of X. Primary and secondary hydroxy groups show different reactivity due to being a part of CDs. Stoddart et al. synthesised compound K, where only one OH group remained free per glucopyranoside unit. equiv.= equivalent

## Current subquestion T9-A2
Tick the favorable chair conformation and draw the structure of K by completing the CD template. Show stereochemistry unambiguously.

semantic_requirements: Bind every atom, bond order, substituent, charge, radical and requested stereocentre to the problem figures.

Derive the requested structure from problem constraints and justified general chemistry rules; do not assume the output.
requested_outputs.source_requirement: complete structure of K, including all requested stereochemistry and template fields
